headline: Foodlink F&B Holdings Sets ₹361 Crore IPO Price Band at ₹181-191 per Share
summary: Foodlink F&B Holdings set its price band at ₹181-191 per share for a ₹361 crore initial public offering opening on November 26, comprising a fresh equity issue worth ₹192 crore.
why: Initial public offerings offer insight into capital market liquidity and investor demand in India's hospitality sector.

impacts.name: Foodlink F&B Holdings
impacts.why: Launching a ₹361 crore IPO provides equity capital for expansion.
